claims: Apollo 11 was the first crewed moon landing.
Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins reached the Moon in 76 hours.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Eagle module on July 20, 1969.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Eagle module at 4:17 p.m. EDT.
Apollo 11's launch vehicle was the Saturn V rocket.
Neil A. Armstrong was Apollo 11 Commander.
Michael Collins was Apollo 11 Command Module Pilot.
Edwin "Buzz" E. Aldrin Jr. was Apollo 11 Lunar Module Pilot.
Apollo 11 landing site was the "Sea of Tranquility" on the lunar surface.
Neil Armstrong said "That's one small step for [a] man, one giant leap for mankind" upon stepping onto the lunar surface.
NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon in 53 years.
